infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PotholeCollect uses the camera to capture pothole photos and videos of the road surface.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PotholeCollect attaches a precise GPS location to every pothole sample. Samples without an accurate, genuine location are rejected.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used while recording pothole videos.
